title: The Flatshare
author: Beth O'Leary
summary: To afford London rent, a woman shares a one-bedroom flat and even the bed with a night-shift nurse she never meets, since their schedules never overlap. They start leaving each other notes, and a friendship grows through sticky labels.
readIf: you want a gentle, warm romance told through notes, with real care for its characters.
skipIf: you want fast flirty banter, as this one is slow and has a thread about emotional abuse.

pairings.reason: Another forced-togetherness romance, but louder and more comedic where this one is soft and thoughtful.
Shares a gentle focus on loneliness, healing and finding a person who is kind to you.
Another romance where old wounds are handled with care and humour.
